Virginia Woolf, To the Lighthouse.
Standard Ebooks edition: https://standardebooks.org/ebooks/virginia-woolf/to-the-lighthouse

People whose words are in the text, and their death years:
- Virginia Woolf, the author, died 1941.

First publication of the text used: 1927 (SE colophon: 'To the Lighthouse was published in 1927 by Virginia Woolf.')

Why this is public domain:
- United States: the text was first published in 1927, before 1931;
  a published work enters the United States public domain 95 years after
  publication, so this work entered it in 2022.
- Country of origin: the facts do not name the country of first publication. The possible countries are the United Kingdom, Ireland, the United States, Canada, Australia, New Zealand, India and South Africa. Each of them has a term of life + 70 years or less. The last person to die did so in 1941, so the work is public domain in each of these countries.

The edition's own statement of rights (from the repository's content.opf):
"The source text and artwork in this ebook are believed to be in the United States public domain; that is, they are believed to be free of copyright restrictions in the United States. They may still be copyrighted in other countries, so users located outside of the United States must check their local laws before using this ebook.
